title: Subsets in Sum Range [L, R]

monster.name: Bandpass Specter
monster.title: Filterer of Interval Energy
monster.defeatQuote: Subsets falling strictly between L and R counted!

description: Given an array of integers `nums` and two integers `low` and `high`, return the number of non-empty subsets whose sum lies in `[low, high]` inclusive.
starterCode:
def subsetsInSumRange(nums: list[int], low: int, high: int) -> int:
    pass
solutionCode:
def subsetsInSumRange(nums: list[int], low: int, high: int) -> int:
    count = 0
    def dfs(idx, curr_sum, picked):
        nonlocal count
        if idx == len(nums):
            if picked and low <= curr_sum <= high: count += 1
            return
        dfs(idx + 1, curr_sum, picked)
        dfs(idx + 1, curr_sum + nums[idx], True)
    dfs(0, 0, False)
    return count
hints: Track sum of picked elements. Verify low <= sum <= high at terminal state.
